intent_en: To demonstrate the extreme concentration of wealth at the top of the economic spectrum to justify a wealth tax as a funding mechanism for social programs.
previous_intent: To demonstrate the extreme wealth inequality between ordinary workers and the ultra-rich, highlighting how a wealth tax could target the massive wealth concentrated at the top to fund social programs.
narration_support: huge amount of wealth stuck here at the very, very top with the ultra -rich. A wealth tax hones in on that.
chart_support: A wealth distribution chart showing net worth for average professions (Cashier, Nurse, Teacher) is near zero, contrasting with a massive vertical spike at the far right representing extreme wealth concentration.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly links a wealth tax to targeting ultra-rich wealth to fund programs, and the chart visualizes this disparity by showing near-zero net worth for average workers and a massive upward curve at the far right.
